{{Top|rwm|can|fotj}} {{Youmay|the episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series|the [[in-universe]] [[Box]] competition structure|linebreak=1}} {{TelevisionEpisode |image=[[File:Epguide417.png]] |title="The Box" |series=''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-box-episode-guide|text="The Box" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} |season=[[The Clone Wars: Season Four|Four]] |episode=17''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]'' |production=4.09 |screener= |airdate=[[February 3]], [[2012]] |intl release= |runtime=24 minutes |director=[[Brian Kalin O'Connell]] |writer=[[Brent Friedman]] |production company= |guests= |canon_timeline=[[20 BBY]]{{TCWcanondates|417}} |legends_timeline=[[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]{{TCWdates|417}} |prev="[[Friends and Enemies]]" |next="[[Crisis on Naboo]]" }} {{Quote|The strong survive, the noble overcome.|Moral|{{TCW|The Box}}}} "'''The Box'''" is the seventeenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]]. It aired on [[February 3]], [[2012]]. "The Box" focuses on several [[bounty hunter]]s' participation in the [[Box]], a perilous competition devised by [[Moralo Eval]]. This is the third episode, in a four-part storyline, about [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s quest to unveil an assassination plot against [[Supreme Chancellor|Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], for which he goes undercover as a bounty hunter named [[Rako Hardeen]]. This storyline began with the preceding two episodes, "[[Deception]]" and "[[Friends and Enemies]]", respectively. ==Official description== ''The disguised Obi-Wan accompanies Cad Bane and Moralo Eval to Serenno, where they enlist in a brutal competition with other bounty hunters from around the galaxy to determine who will participate in a plot to kidnap the Chancellor.'' ==Opening narration== {{OpeningCrawl |name=Episode 17
THE BOX |text=Obi-Wan Kenobi in disguise! Working undercover as assassin Rako Hardeen, Obi-Wan leads a secret mission to uncover the Separatist plot against Chancellor Palpatine. Using cunning and courage, he gains the trust of bounty hunter Cad Bane and criminal mastermind Moralo Eval, earning him entrance into the stronghold of Separatist leader, Count Dooku. Now, it is here, on the beautiful planet of Serenno, that a barbaric contest will determine the fate of Obi-Wan Kenobi and possibly the Republic itself....}} ==Plot summary== {{Quote|Go now, enter The Box, if you have the courage.|Moralo Eval|}} The trio consisting of the [[Rako Hardeen|disguised]] Obi-Wan, Moralo Eval, and Cad Bane arrives at [[Castle Serenno]] on [[Serenno]], where the [[Dooku|Count]] himself welcomes them, although the latter chastises Eval for his delay. From the Count, Obi-Wan and Bane learn that a contest is about to take place, and the two of them are invited to participate. The participants already on site include some of the galaxy's most successful—and notorious—bounty hunters: Next to Bane and Obi-Wan's disguise template, are [[Embo]], [[Derrown]], [[Twazzi]], [[Sixtat]], [[Jakoli]], [[Mantu]], [[Kiera Swan]], [[Sinrich]], and [[Onca]] (whose [[Bulduga|brother]] was just moments before murdered by Bane for his hat). Unarmed, all of them are to face a life-and-death challenge in the Box, a huge floating structure designed by Eval and filled with deathtraps; and only the first five survivors will be chosen for the task Dooku has in store for them, in return for a handsome reward. Meanwhile, in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant, [[Anakin Skywalker]]'s suspicions about Obi-Wan are in the meantime confirmed by none other than Master [[Yoda]] himself, who apologizes for the deception but also makes it clear that due to Anakin's temper it would become too dangerous for Obi-Wan to involve himself in the mission. [[File:RoguesGallery-SWI132.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The contestants of The Box]] Once they have been transferred into the Box, the contestants meet their first challenge: [[dioxis]] [[gas]] seeping from the floor. The bounty hunters race to the rising platforms, believing that they will be safe from the poison if they stay high enough. However, the platforms continue to rise, threatening to crush the bounty hunters. Obi-Wan correctly deduces that the escape route is beneath them, and using his helmet's filters, discovers the exit. All the bounty hunters follow Obi-Wan and take no casualties. They soon arrive for the second challenge, where they must escape the room. Eval starts the challenge and sends out horizontal columns with a laser spike tip which seemingly move at random. Obi-Wan notices that the columns move in a pattern to allow the bounty hunters to escape from the exit, located at the ceiling. While most of the bounty hunters manage to follow Obi-Wan lead, Onca, Swan and Sinrich are killed. Dooku notices that "Hardeen" is carrying everyone and tells Eval to watch him closely. The group arrives for the third challenge as a serum appears before the bounty hunters. Eval tells them that for this third challenge, one of them must take the serum and deactivate the [[ray shield]] cage. However, the serum is toxic to all but one of them. Eval raises the platform and the ray shield, electrocuting Jakoli who is caught off-guard. Derrown goes for the serum, but is stopped by Bane. However, Obi-Wan allows Derrown to take the serum, as the physiology of his race should allow him to survive the serum's effects. Derrown moves through the ray shield and manages to deactivate the switch, though Mantu is killed in the process. The contestants proceed to the final challenge, where Eval explains to them that they must shoot a moving holographic target with a sniper rifle. If they miss one shot, then they will be killed by the pop-up flamethrowers below. Sixtat volunteers himself and lands the first few shots. However, he misses the final one, prompting Eval to drop him to his doom as the others watch. Obi-Wan then volunteers himself. However, Eval, now jealous of "Hardeen's" successes, deceptively loads Obi-Wan's rifle with four shots while demanding that he shoot down five. Obi-Wan realizes the deception too late and Eval attempts to drop him to his doom. Bane, now having newfound respect for Obi-Wan and disgusted by Eval's cowardice in killing him, saves him with his [[Whipcord launcher|whipcord]], demanding that he kill him off like a man. Dooku, also aware of Eval's cowardice, wishes to see him fight too and forces the [[Phindian]] into the arena. Eval fights dirty by using probe droids and altering the arena into a small maze, but Obi-Wan destroys his control bracelet. Dooku demands that "Hardeen" kill Eval, but he refuses, stating that he just wants to get his money. Dooku is disappointed by his refusal. Nevertheless, he and his surviving compatriots are declared winners of the challenge and are entrusted with the Count's plan: to kidnap Supreme Chancellor [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] as he goes to visit [[Naboo]] and hold him hostage in exchange for the release of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] leaders who have been captured by the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] in the course of the [[Clone Wars|war]]. Dooku assigns Bane to be the strike team's leader, after witnessing Eval's lack of combat skills and "Hardeen's" apparent reluctance to kill off his opponents. ==Media==
